item.title: Tractor-Trailer Crash Knocks Down Power Lines, Closes Portion of Route 61 in Schuylkill Haven
item.description: A section of Route. 61 (Center Avenue) in Schuylkill Haven is temporarily closed after a tractor-trailer struck multiple utility poles Friday, bringing power lines down across the roadway. According to the Schuylkill Haven Borough Police Department, the southbound lanes of Route 61 are shut down beginning at Center Avenue and Dock Street. item.title: New Troopers Graduate from Pennsylvania State Police Academy, Join Ranks Across the Commonwealth
item.description: The Pennsylvania State Police officially welcomed 49 new troopers into its ranks Friday as the 174th Cadet Class graduated during a ceremony at LCBC Manheim. Commissioner Colonel Christopher Paris delivered remarks and administered the oath, acknowledging the cadets’ completion of approximately 27 weeks of rigorous physical, academic, and scenario-based training. item.description: Knoebels Amusement Resort has officially turned on the lights for its annual holiday drive-through spectacular, Joy Through the Grove, now open nightly from 5:30 to 9:00 p.m. through December 31, excluding Christmas Eve and Christmas Day.
